panel.title: Admin Panel
panel.subtitle: Manage users, roles, and staff accounts
panel.addStaffHint: Staff will be assigned the default password and must change it on first login.
panel.confirmReset:
Reset password for {name} to default?

They will be logged out everywhere and must change the password at next login.
panel.resetDone: Password reset. User must change on next login.
panel.resetNetwork: Failed to reset password — network error
panel.confirmDelete:
Delete account for {name}?

This is permanent and cannot be undone.

setup.title: School Setup Automation
setup.body: Upload a school-setup.json file to automatically initialize the academic session, fee categories, designations, grades, and classes. This action should only be performed once on a fresh setup.
setup.error: An error occurred during setup execution.

unlocks.HR_ADMIN: HR Portal — staff attendance, leave policies, payroll and salary setup.
unlocks.SUB_ADMIN: Day-to-day admin — students, staff, subjects, sections, enrolment and fees.
unlocks.LIBRARIAN: Library — book catalogue, issuing, returns and overdue tracking.
unlocks.TEACHER: Classroom tools — attendance, homework, marks entry and AI teaching aids.

roles.primaryHint: Who this person is in the school. One only, and it is the role their dashboard is built around.
roles.cannotChangeOwn: You cannot change your own primary role.
roles.onlySuperAdmin: Only a super admin can change the primary role.
roles.additionalHint: Extra work this person also does. Access adds up — an admin who also holds HR Admin keeps the admin panel and gains the HR Portal.
roles.blockedBody: A {role} login is a portal identity tied to one person's relationship with the school. Staff access belongs on a separate staff account.
roles.alreadyPrimary: Already held as the primary role — nothing to add.
roles.alreadyPrimaryTitle: This is already the primary role
roles.keepsAccess: {name} keeps their current access until they sign out and sign in again.
roles.tokenNote: Role changes are written into the sign-in token, so they reach this person the next time they sign in — not straight away.

assistant.allStaffHint: Everyone except people you block below.
assistant.onlyChosenHint: Turn it on person by person below, admins included. Super Admins always have access.
assistant.noLimitHint: Anyone with access can use the school's credits until they run out.
assistant.limitEachHint: Applies to everyone without their own limit, admins included.
assistant.bulkDescription: Sets the monthly limit for everyone selected. Anyone you cannot change is skipped.
assistant.superAdminsAlwaysAccess: Super Admins always have access to the AI Assistant.
assistant.cannotChangeOwnAccess: You cannot change your own access.
assistant.notAllowedHint: Their open conversation stops within a minute.
assistant.cannotChangeOwnLimit: You cannot change your own limit.
assistant.ownLimitHint: Counts from the 1st of each month.
assistant.usedOnDays: Used on {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in {month}.
assistant.loadFailed: Could not load AI Assistant access.
assistant.couldNotLoad: AI Assistant access could not load
assistant.usedByStaffHintOthers: credits in {month}, plus {others} by former or deactivated staff
assistant.footer: Credits are shared by the whole school and reset on the 1st of each month. Only a Super Admin manages this page; Super Admins always have full access, and nobody can change their own.
